title: Why France and Turkey are giving defense cooperation another go
gist: France and Turkey signed a defense cooperation roadmap in October 2026, signaling pragmatic cooperation as Russia's war and US retrenchment raise Europe's need for Turkey's military scale and fast-growing defense industry. Reopened SAMP/T air-defense talks and NATO's stalled South Caucasus partnerships are the key tests of durability.
